entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 serves as the official universal memory layer for Hermes Agent, offering multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This context database organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system for efficient retrieval. It achieves significant token reduction and task-completion gains by archiving sessions as editable Markdown files for memory extraction.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee provides persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that processes text, code, and session history. It is designed for local operation and does not require external API keys from providers like OpenAI or Anthropic.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine utilizes a custom vector graph engine to provide sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication for high-volume token processing. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from sources including PDFs, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain functions as an opinionated agent brain that creates knowledge graphs with typed edges without requiring LLM calls. It supports multi-user company environments with scoped data access and provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a long-term memory workflow focused on retain, recall, and reflect operations. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and offers flexible deployment options via Docker, Kubernetes, and multiple programming language clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library that enables stateful agents through background reasoning to update peer representations from session history. It supports managed, local, or Docker deployments and serves as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like commit, branch, and merge over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, ensuring sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression and temporal recall with recency boosting, integrating via MCP or a Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os employs a seven-layer system including vector search on Qdrant and structured facts to manage agent persistence. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness generates filesystem-first artifacts like traces and context bundles to assist agents with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion, ensuring context changes are only saved based on verified successful trials.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes-LCM is a lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools such as lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise recovery of session details.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This project indexes session history from 34 different coding agents into a single shared memory for millisecond lookups over gigabytes of data. It enables searching months of past sessions while ensuring safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers for persistent, private agent memory.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes a human-readable YAML engram format to store memory locally for multi-agent systems. It employs hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context across global, team, and project-specific scopes.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI offers a local-first identity and memory layer that achieves 97.6% accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It automates memory construction from Discord, Obsidian, and office documents to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, utilizing hybrid retrieval that combines BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a durable, file-based system that avoids vector databases and embeddings in favor of a five-tier SQLite schema with FTS5 search. It provides a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and MCP server.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% in tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result. It manages the memory lifecycle by tracking contradictions and performing hygiene passes, supporting both embedded and HTTP backend execution.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI acts as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, preserving citations and temporal memory without vector databases. It allows agents to autonomously recall and evolve persistent knowledge through portable archives.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, ensuring memory remains daemonless and user-owned.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration with major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets to the agent for every query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal for information retrieval. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It facilitates source-neutral migrations for chat and document exports to ensure reviewed context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to surface high-priority entries during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate, permanent event deletion. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to pay for API services directly.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin routes agent queries to local skills, runbooks, and scripts using automatically generated routing notes. It provides native tools for knowledge search, retrieval, and neighbor traversal across connected MCP servers.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing Hermes to read and share durable memories with other connected agents. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer for caching and outbox syncing alongside semantic search capabilities.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes Agent. It supports manual memory storage and offers configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through a required SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It utilizes HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication to manage long-term agent memory.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It maintains agent continuity by performing automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit implements a file-based memory hygiene loop that uses a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage without a database. It features five slash commands and specialized curators to identify data rot, resolve contradictions, and propose evidence-cited updates.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology centered on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates the transition from spec elicitation to implementation planning while supporting various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It enables agents to export designs into multiple formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to convert codebases, schemas, and infrastructure-as-code into draw.io diagrams via natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and includes an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates delegated permissions and x402 payments. It integrates a master router with a verification and dispute resolution layer to manage natural-language mandates.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It identifies 74 specific structural and conversational categories to refine agent-generated text.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for Hermes and other compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and managing the collective evolution of skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state locally within a project's documentation folder to ensure continuity.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,162 markdown-based skills designed for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. The skills are distributed under an MIT license and require no external runtime or telemetry.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin provides capabilities for searching YouTube, browsing channels, and extracting transcripts or playlists. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and other IDE-based agents, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds to streamline the creation of new agent capabilities.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches agents to generate their own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first, Git-based harness that operates without background services using a three-layer system of kernels, plugins, and recipes. It implements the SLP protocol to facilitate supervised coordination among cooperative agents.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for production tasks like VPS management and cron automation. It supports localized integrations for platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams, and is installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX image and video generation. The suite includes eight specialist skills and supports polling and webhooks via the BFL API.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing and testing, linking specific instructions directly to file lines or URLs.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI that uses a Rust binary and four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local execution records and journals within a dedicated traces directory.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution for installations and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It includes built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for validating Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a central discovery and installation hub that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face, operating autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure to facilitate community skill browsing.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token consumption and includes graceful degradation for environments missing embedding models.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system that integrates Hermes Agent via MCP to manage habits, study blocks, and scheduling. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces through a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This security-focused skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration vulnerabilities. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings executed in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across various interfaces including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, supporting 97 different languages. It is designed to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite while evaluating prompts across five quality dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three specialized agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes an approval gate for managing implementation risks.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python-based goal engine to maintain persistent task states during complex debugging and reproduction efforts.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills provide session management and worktree recovery to maintain memory across agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy while offering optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts with vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final optimized file into a README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills for integration with clients like Hermes and Cursor. It streamlines the discovery process by providing direct installation commands for identified plugins and tools.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specifications to detect and report drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with specific runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement loop that analyzes session history to identify skill gaps and propose structured updates. All modifications are gated behind an evaluation framework using deterministic and LLM-judge tests, operating entirely locally without external daemons.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to navigate environment-specific path syntax across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It also automates the selection and verification of project-compatible Python interpreters without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and supports Hermes Agent and OpenClaw environments.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for video transcription, OCR, and content refinement, including a rule-based engine to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns. It utilizes macOS Vision to extract structured data from PDFs and images for e-commerce and documentation workflows.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies the functional quality of agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for managing bounty boards and buying context, with payments distributed automatically upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This toolkit offers skills and blueprints for lead enrichment, social data retrieval, and web scraping across multiple agent platforms. It provides pre-packaged workflows for specific roles such as SEO and prospecting, supported by a workspace Postgres database.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It produces structured briefings that include core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to align search expansions with specific user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents and development tools that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both terminal-based and desktop environments, offering a reproducible way to manage Hermes alongside other AI tools.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository features an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices using Termux. It provides configuration guides for OpenClaw and utilizes Termux:API and Termux:GUI to grant the agent hardware and user interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This Termux-based installer uses proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android devices with support for shell command execution and gateway services. It allows for interactive model setup using either local models via Ollama or external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables Kubernetes deployments with enforced single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including configurable gateway modes with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using REST, CLI, and MCP interfaces. It features a catalog for 69 credentials and 17+ LLM providers, securing all secrets with AES-256-GCM encryption.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes workspaces and settings. It supports hybrid skill management and integrates with sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs through Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable package allows Hermes to run from a USB drive or any external disk without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, fundamental, and sentiment analysis to execute financial trading strategies. It ensures point-in-time data integrity during backtesting and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI or CLI. It supports local Node.js installation or Docker deployment, offering memory browsing and MCP server integration for workflow management.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages coding agents like Hermes and Claude using persistent tmux sessions for background execution and container-based isolation. It provides a TUI and web dashboard for overseeing Git worktree management and multi-agent coordination.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs across specialist teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes from single VPS agents to automated teams via a task bus delegation pattern. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It integrates with over 23 LLM providers and supports MCP tools to extend agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous tasks and a live stream of agent reasoning. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure quality and implementation standards.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a dedicated Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization tool automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena-style framework orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution, visualizing the competition through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It leverages Ollama for parallel model querying and synthesis without relying on cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a 100% local, pre-indexed knowledge graph that enables Hermes Agent to resolve cross-file dependencies in TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust. By integrating via MCP, it reduces token usage and tool calls by providing the agent with structured codebase context without requiring a Node.js runtime.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that monitors token consumption across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a TUI and a web-based dashboard for visualizing usage data, which can be submitted to a public leaderboard or profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other CLI-based coding tools. It enhances security by redacting authentication headers before recording sessions into self-contained HTML files for detailed inspection.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and over 37 other AI tools directly. It supports multi-device synchronization to ensure usage data and session details remain consistent across different machines.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help Hermes Agent and other providers build better user interfaces. It integrates via markdown or general prompting to assist agents in generating structured UI components.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It comes pre-loaded with 36 skills and 6 workflows designed for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides a collection of community-contributed themes and CLI skins to customize the Hermes terminal interface. Users can create and apply YAML-based configurations to change ASCII art banners, spinners, and color schemes.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate securely using encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports agent identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates financial transactions using USDC and SOL on the Solana network.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF support, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through a dedicated supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends these memory capabilities to chat platforms such as Slack, Telegram, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps, finance, and research with an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic analysis of AI agent configurations and system prompts without requiring runtime model execution. It enforces HERM v1.1 scoring by detecting ambiguous descriptions and contract mismatches, integrating directly into CI workflows via GitHub Actions or pre-commit hooks.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for local configurations and specialized skills. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This setup tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services in minutes at zero cost. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories for rapid production readiness.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It utilizes zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local monetization tasks, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network runtime that requires explicit approval for all external writes. It implements specific contracts for opportunities and offer-previews to ensure human oversight for every consequential action.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word-activated interaction to Hermes Agent across 35 languages without requiring API keys. The system supports adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities using Piper and Kokoro for local speech processing.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for agent data. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and features a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This Tauri 2-based manager provides a cross-platform interface for configuring and switching between Hermes Agent and other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one desktop controller for agent environments.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that features a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities for Hermes Agent. It enables 24/7 scheduled automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI or various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices without a complex build step. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This companion application simplifies the lifecycle of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single desktop environment.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This dashboard offers visual workflow building with human approval gates and scheduling for Hermes Agent tasks. It supports multi-platform channel configuration for services like Telegram and Slack, alongside analytics for tracking token costs and model distribution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager to provide a comprehensive development environment.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote session management.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri and Rust, featuring a specialized kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing native window and process management for Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension bridges active browser context with local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It allows users to switch between multi-agent profiles and use AI-assisted tab scoping to control the context sent to the agent.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for server workspaces and scheduled tasks.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, including custom LLM model routing. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based consciousness monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics behind a secure login. It features an MCP server control plane for lifecycle management and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session token burn and estimated API costs for Codex and Claude. It allows users to search local agent histories for prompts and tool calls, with support for resuming sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It includes an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for ComfyUI and TTS, alongside a dynamic tool maker for runtime API integration.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management for separating sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
